cmds.description: Show a list of all commands

gsban.description: Globally ban a user from every server the bot is in

gsunban.description: Unban a user from every server the bot is in

sr.description: Save this server's assignable roles at or above the configured threshold

tar.description: Remove this server's assignable roles at or above the configured threshold

gar.description: Restore this server's saved roles at or above the configured threshold

clear.description: Clear recent messages and save a transcript

cleartranscript.description: Retrieve a clear transcript by its ID

lockchannel.description: Prevent everyone and the configured role from typing in this channel

unlock.description: Restore this channel's saved typing permissions
